Russia-Africa ties: Moscow's growing influence in Africa
The third Russia-Africa Summit is due to bring African leaders to Moscow at the end of October, as ties between Russia and the continent continue to grow. The Kremlin has sought to expand its influence in Africa amid its isolation from the US and Europe, while African governments have pursued closer economic, diplomatic and security ties with Moscow.

Russia has also sought to draw African recruits into its war in Ukraine. Four years after the invasion, Kyiv estimates that around 3,000 Africans have ended up fighting for Moscow on the front lines. Rep.  Chuck Edwards  (R-N.C.) filed a complaint against the top Republican and Democrat on the House Ethics Committee on Tuesday, accusing the lawmakers who investigated him of breaking their own rules.   Why it matters:  Edwards is escalating his fight against the committee just two weeks after the House voted 413-2 to  censure him  over its findings that he violated House rules related to sexual harassment and a hostile workplace. Israel and Morocco agree to open embassies after New York talks
Israel and Morocco agreed on Wednesday to open embassies in each other’s countries following talks between their foreign ministers and the US ambassador to the United Nations in New York. The two countries established diplomatic ties in 2020 under the US-brokered Abraham Accords, which normalised Israel’s relations with several Arab states.

India, Pakistan summon each other’s diplomats after naval ships collide in Arabian Sea
New Delhi and Islamabad summoned each other’s top diplomats to lodge strong protests after an Indian and a Pakistani naval vessel collided in international waters.
India’s foreign ministry said that it had called in Pakistan’s senior envoy to formally register a strong objection over what it said was “unacceptable and unprofessional conduct” of Pakistani naval units that led to a collision with an Indian warship.

第23届中国-东盟博览会今天开幕
今天，第23届中国—东盟博览会在广西南宁开幕。本届东博会，有70多个国家和地区的3400多家企业参展，东帝汶首次以共办方身份亮相，这也是东盟扩容以后11国首次在南宁齐聚。今年的东博会还首次设置东盟国家需求展区，智能撮合企业精准对接。与此同时，第23届中国—东盟商务与投资峰会也将于今天开始在广西南宁举行。

我国绿色贸易进出口规模居全球首位
今天（17日），《中国绿色贸易发展报告（2026）》发布。报告显示，2025年，我国绿色贸易进出口额达到8022.51亿美元，占全球绿色贸易总额的14.68%，规模居全球首位。节能降碳类和清洁能源类产品合计占我国绿色产品出口的82.35%，成为绿色出口的两大主力。
main_items.title: 我国绿色贸易进出口规模居全球首位
